description: Placement of T, U, C, S (L fixed as the segment from (-1/2,0) to (1/2,0)) with the smallest hull area found by local minimization from 300 random starting points. Layout: (phi, t_x, t_y) for T, U, C, S, as in the paper; angles reduced to the root box of the certificate.
note: hull area in double precision from the exact arc data; not part of the proof
